components.name: Primary action
components.description: Dark conversion action with a Relay blue hover state.

narrative.overview: White paper, precise ink, Relay blue and dark delivery surfaces frame real CRM evidence. The approved product identity connects sales context to client commitments.

rules.name: Public evidence boundary
rules.body: Use pure display components and local fixtures. AppSidebarView is separate from the authenticated adapter; ui/display is separate from editors and date picker. Disable private prefetch. Public / skips Supabase claims refresh. Recursive landing-isolation tests protect this boundary.

dos: Preserve the approved sales-to-delivery positioning and palette.
Keep product evidence read-only and clearly identified as demonstration data.
donts: Do not invent customer proof or commercial outcomes.
Do not replace real UI evidence with image mockups or connect public previews to private providers.
